title: Best Laptops for Travel (2026): Which to Take on the Road
summary: Having brought many different laptops on work trips, I can say these are the best portable computers for travel, based on my personal testing.
llm_summary: The article shares the author’s hands‑on picks for the most travel‑friendly laptops in 2026, highlighting models that combine light weight, long battery life, robust build quality, and reliable performance for work on the road.
